officialName: Revopoint MIRACO Pro 3D Scanner (32 GB RAM)
description: The Revopoint MIRACO Pro is a standalone handheld 3D scanner that uses infrared structured light, with its own screen and processor, so you can scan without a computer. In a makerspace, students use it to turn real objects into digital models for 3D printing, reverse engineering, replacement parts and colour models. It covers everything from small parts in Near mode to cars and people in Far mode, with up to 0.05 mm single-frame accuracy.

specs.label: Output file formats
specs.value: PLY, OBJ, STL, ASC, 3MF, GLTF, FBX

specs.label: Battery
specs.value: Internal 5000 mAh, up to 2 hours of scanning

materials: Dark, reflective or transparent objects (with scanning spray)
useRestrictions: Not suitable for objects smaller than 10 × 10 × 10 mm, and its flashing lights may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.
